signals.label: M7.7 furniture and fit PR #35
signals.scope: M7.7 was exact-head verified, product-owner accepted and squash-merged. It proves the searchable furniture catalogue, M2-derived fit explanations, selected-object inspector, atomic Apply and one-step semantic Undo described by that milestone. It does not prove final plan-recognition accuracy.

signals.label: M7.8A recognition benchmark PR #40
signals.scope: M7.8A established an eight-fixture public-safe benchmark, deterministic geometry/topology/opening/room/area/confidence metrics and real Chromium/OpenCV source execution. Product-owner calibration acceptance covered image-rectangle coordinates and undirected horizontal/vertical calibration. The accepted baseline intentionally exposed zero Source wall and opening F1 before quality tuning.

signals.label: M7.8B wall topology PR #41
signals.scope: The Draft PR reports exact-head green Standard CI, Recognition Benchmark and browser audit plus measured wall-geometry improvement to Core F1 0.834356 and Source F1 0.518519. It remains pending product-owner real-plan acceptance. Openings are deliberately deferred fail-closed, Source topology remains below the final 0.90 target, and rooms, labels and areas are unfinished.

signals.label: LivingWorld CI run 29736858315
signals.scope: Exact-head CI для milestone world perception прошёл проверки Java 21 и pinned dependencies, unit/storage/migration/perception/trust/package/reproducibility tests, отдельный RC resilience scenario, Fabric GameTest, staging release artifact и загрузку JAR artifact. Это не подтверждает ручную приёмку двух реальных клиентов, микрофона или spatial audio.

signals.label: World perception milestone PR #6
signals.scope: Milestone server-observed world perception и trusted knowledge был merged после documented exact-head verification. Это подтверждает именно этот milestone, а не полную готовность multiplayer release.
